system.description:
You know how to use your strength to batter an opponent to the ground, knocking him or her Prone.

Prerequisites: Bantha Rush, Trip

Effect: Whenever you successfully move a creature with the Bantha Rush Feat, you also knock that target Prone.

prerequisite.text: Bantha Rush feat, and Trip feat
